title: Neighbor notable vertex fraction
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a table of functions from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$. The neighbor notable vertex fraction is the expected indicator, for a uniformly selected vertex, that the set of notable coordinates of its averaged neighbor function is nonempty.
